name: The Vedas
translation: Rigveda Sacred Hymns — Ralph T.H. Griffith & Wendy Doniger

sections.name: Rigveda Hymns of Dawn, Creation, and Peace

verses.text: Then was not non-existence nor existence; there was no realm of air, no sky beyond it. What covered it, and where? And what gave shelter? Was water there, unfathomed depth of water?
verses.original: नासदासीन्नो सदासीत्तदानीं नासीद्रजो नो व्योमा परो यत् । किमावरीवः कुह कस्य शर्मन्नम्भः किमासीद्गहनं गभीरम् ॥
verses.transliteration: Nāsad āsīn no sad āsīt tadānīṁ...

verses.text: Death was not then, nor was there aught immortal; no sign was there, the day’s and night’s divider. That One Thing, breathless, breathed by its own nature; apart from it was nothing whatsoever.
verses.original: न मृत्युरासीदमृतं न तर्हि न रात्र्या अह्न आसीत्प्रकेतः । आनीदवातं स्वधया तदेकं तस्माद्धान्यन्न परः किञ्चनास ॥
verses.transliteration: Na mṛtyur āsīd amṛtaṁ na tarhi...

verses.text: Darkness there was; at first concealed in darkness, this all was undifferentiated water. That which had become enclosed in void, that One arose through the power of warmth (tapas).
verses.original: तम आसीत्तमसा गूळ्हमग्रेऽप्रकेतं सलिलं सर्वमा इदम् । तुच्छ्येनाभ्वपिहितं यदासीत्तपसस्तन्महिनाजायतैकम् ॥

chapters.name: Gayatri & Sam No Mitra (Hymns of Light & Harmony)
chapters.subtitle: Prayers for universal illumination and cosmic peace

verses.text: We meditate on the adorable effulgence of that Divine Sun (Savitur); may that light inspire and illumine our understanding.
verses.original: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
verses.transliteration: Oṁ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ tat savitur vareṇyaṁ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt.

verses.text: May your purpose be one; may your hearts be in harmony; may your minds be in common accord, so that there may be a happy union among you.
verses.original: समानी व आकूतिः समाना हृदयानि वः । समानमस्तु वो मनो यथा वः सुसहासति ॥
verses.transliteration: Samānī va ākūtiḥ samānā hṛdayāni vaḥ...
